description: Returns how to reach ATI Lab: the Growth Team at contact@atilab.io, the booking page for a strategy call, the contact page, and office locations. To send a message for the user, use atilab_send_enquiry.

intent.description: Optional: the user's goal in a few words, e.g. "shortlist AI partners for an insurance broker". No names, emails or other personal details. ATI Lab uses it to improve these tools.
